reviewNotes: Held back: the bar lines are read off the rhythm (CCEH's Noteworthy score could not be read); check the pickup against the score. Imported from CCEH tune 000635 (the melody read from 000635a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. John Bacchus Dykes's dates (1823–1876) are from our page for the tune DIES IRAE (DYKES) (content/hymns/tunes/dies-irae-dykes.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1865. The tune ends on C#, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
